## Websites {#网站}

::: {.contribution authors="unknown" status="unverified"}

- XJTLU website directory: <https://guide.xjtlu.edu.cn>

- Personal information portal, ebridge: <https://ebridge.xjtlu.edu.cn>

- University of Liverpool portal, Liverpool Life: <https://liverpool-life.liverpool.ac.uk>

:::

## Where to find frequently used resources {#常用资源位置}

::: {.contribution authors="unknown" status="unverified"}

- XJTLU PGR Handbook, University policies and regulations: log in to ebridge and find "PGR Policies, Procedures and Forms" in the centre of the page.

- University of Liverpool PGR Handbook: <https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/student-administration/research-students/pgr-handbook/>

- Campus map: see [Campus map](campus-map.qmd#xp-guide-campus-map) in the appendix, or search WeChat for the "西浦地图" mini program.

- Academic calendar: after logging in to ebridge, select "Academic Calendar" on the left.

- Useful phone numbers: see [University contacts](contacts.qmd#xp-guide-contacts) in the appendix.

:::
